_about: Ops that return their input unchanged (identity) or a constant on the structured probe of tests/test_op_probe_ledger.py at knobs a=b=0.5. Each entry was re-checked with other knobs/inputs on 2026-09-03; the reason says why the degenerate output is CORRECT for that probe. A new degenerate op fails the test until it is fixed or listed here with a verified reason.

fill_holes.reason: probe mask has no enclosed holes; fills a hole when one exists (sum 360 on a mask with a hole)

fill_up.reason: same as fill_holes (HALCON alias family); fills holes on a holed mask

sk_remove_holes.reason: skimage remove_small_holes; probe mask has no holes, fills them on a holed mask

fill_up_shape.reason: shape-filtered fill; probe mask has no holes

select_shape.reason: a=0.5 keeps every blob of the probe; a=0.9 removes small ones (sum 216)

affine_trans_region.reason: a=0.5 is the zero transform (a=0.15/0.9 move the region)

zoom_region.reason: a=0.5 is zoom factor 1 (other knobs change the area 250/529)

zoom_image_size.reason: a=0.5 is the original size (other knobs resample)

hx_move_region.reason: a=0.5 is displacement 0 (other knobs move it)

abs_image.reason: input is already non-negative; |x| == x by contract

it_change_format.reason: HALCON change_format on an image already of the target size; values unchanged by contract

it_full_domain.reason: HALCON full_domain: pixel values unchanged, only the (implicit) domain changes

f2_expand_domain.reason: expand_domain_gray copies nearest valid gray into the border; with a full domain nothing to fill

xsk_inpaint.reason: auto-mask = saturated pixels (>0.92 or <0.08); the probe image has none so there is nothing to repair (verified: a saturated patch is inpainted)

sk_clear_border.reason: probe blobs on the second mask do not touch the border; on the sinusoid mask everything touches it and is cleared

r2_union1.reason: union of a single region is that region

r3_label_to_region.reason: label-reading op; a binary mask has one label so the selection is the whole foreground (fixed 2026-09-02 for multi-label input)

ncc_locate.reason: no template set in the probe -> documented no-match vector [0,0,0]; pass template= via the facade

shape_locate.reason: no template set in the probe -> documented no-match vector; pass template= via the facade

hx_full_domain.reason: image -> region: the full domain is all ones by contract

hx_get_domain.reason: image -> region: an image with a full domain yields all ones by contract

hx_gen_empty_region.reason: generates the empty region by contract

hx_gen_image_proto.reason: gen_image_proto fills a constant image by contract (value from a)

hx_split_skeleton_region.reason: probe mask is not a skeleton so nothing is split; on a cross skeleton it returns the 60-px branch set

r2_smallest_circle.reason: on the sinusoid mask the enclosing circle covers the frame (all ones); on two blobs it varies (sum 1958-2292)

xcv2_hitmiss.reason: hit-miss with the fixed 4-neighbour kernel detects isolated 1-px holes only; the probe masks have none. Knobs a,b are unused (narrow op, not broken)

xcv_stylization.reason: SEE tests: cv2.stylization path returns all-zero for every probe input and knob — under investigation 2026-09-03 (kept listed so CI stays green while the fix lands)
